newsitem.title: UK: P&U names AHP's Hassan chief exec.
newsitem.headline: P&U names AHP's Hassan chief exec.

text.p: Swedish-U.S. drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc said on Sunday that it had appointed American Home Products Corp executive vice president Fred Hassan as its new president and chief executive officer. In a statement, Pharmacia & Upjohn said Hassan, 51, would take up the post immediately. The company has been searching for a new chief executive since the surprise resignation of John Zabriskie in January.
The company said Jan Ekberg, who stepped into Zabriskie's shoes on a temporary basis, would resume his position as chairman of the board.
Ekberg said Hassan was "exactly the right person to lead Pharmacia & Upjohn into the 21st century."

He said he had "demonstrated leadership ability, the successful experience of running global operations and the organisational skills to complete the integration of the businesses and blend the cultures of Pharmacia & Upjohn."

Hassan said P&U faced "some clear challenges, but I am convinced of our strong fundamentals - global reach, a powerful R&D (research and development) base and a solid new-product pipeline." The new chief executive officer has spent 26 years in the pharmaceutical industry, including 17 years with Sandoz Pharmaceuticals Corp in the U.S. He joined AHP in 1989 as president of its Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories division. Since November 1995 he has had responsibility for AHP's global pharmaceutical, medical device and nutrition businesses as well as research and development. P&U said Hassan was a U.S. citizen of Pakistani origin. He received a bachelor of science degree from Imperial College, London, and an MBA from Harvard.
